Welcome to Pets & Vets, the home of all things animals.

We are a channel dedicated to our favourite felines, man's best friends and animal odd couples! We publish the funny and fantastic furry friends in our life with content to entertain and amuse.

Pets & Vets is part of the Little Dot Studios Network. To get in touch please email owned-enquiries@littledotstudios.com.
